summary: ```markdown # Marvelous Designer Tips Sharing: Clothing Details Edition ## Introduction Welcome to my channel! Today, I will show you how to make a double-sided sewing machine. This guide will help you understand the differences and applications of the double-sided sewing machine in Marvelous Designer. ## Understanding the Double-Sided Sewing Machine First, let's clarify what a double-sided sewing machine is. The double-sided sewing machine can only be used in a 3D window. To start, select the double-sided sewing machine and click on 10 points. Click at the end of the creation to create the first set of double-sided sewing machines. Then, use the same method to create the other side. After hiding the sewing machine, you can notice the difference between the two sides. The part where the double-sided sewing machine is used has a line gap and cannot set the folding angle or the type of sewing machine. ## Setting the Length of the Line After displaying the sewing machine, use the double-sided sewing machine to set the length of the line. You can adjust the length of the line in the property editor. To prevent the sheet from falling, press W first and click on the sheet. Add a fixed needle to secure the sheet in the 3D window. After setting the length of the line, you may notice that the middle part is opened. If you continue to increase the length of the line, the gap in the middle will become larger. ## Adjusting Line Length If you make cuts using the double-sided sewing machine, you can easily adjust the length of the line. Here you are! After adjusting the length, the lines will be re-selected. Press W with the double-sided sewing machine to set the length again. Please note that the direction of the sewing needle should match the direction of the sewing thread. If the directions differ, there will be an unstable situation when the sewing thread is crossed and simulated. ## Sewing Techniques When sewing, you can sew one short side and one long side simultaneously. Additionally, you can use a cut-off seam inside the board. If the direction of the sewing needle is inconsistent, it may lead to instability during simulation. If your pants fall down easily, consider using a virtual model line seam to sew the clothes and secure them on the model. ## Fixing Clothing Issues To better fix issues like the belt sliding down on pants, we can use the clip-on tool. Click on the belt and the pants to stabilize them. Sew the left and right sides of the strap. If you simulate directly, the small strap may fall down because it is not fixed. Hence, we can use the fake sewing tool to secure the small strap on the big strap. ## Managing Gaps Between Strap Layers You might notice a larger gap between each layer of the strap. To address this, we can reduce the impact thickness of the strap, which will decrease the gap. However, simulating this directly may cause instability. Therefore, we should stabilize the simulation layer by layer and then simulate the outer layer of the strap. In this example, observe that there is a significant gap between each layer of the strap and the outer layer. ## Conclusion After adjusting the length of the line, you can control the position of the small tie. Thank you for watching! Please subscribe to our channel for more tips and tricks on using Marvelous Designer effectively. ```
